market_name: Charlotte, NC visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: OBSERVATION box, not an admission boundary. It covers Mecklenburg County, North Carolina in full plus every fringe town PTF-CHARLOTTE-NC-ZERO-TO-LIVE-BENCHMARK-001 was told to evaluate rather than assume: Concord and Kannapolis (Cabarrus), Belmont and Gastonia (Gaston), Harrisburg, Mooresville and the north Lake Norman shore (Iredell), Monroe / Indian Trail / Waxhaw (Union), and across the state line Fort Mill, Tega Cay, Indian Land and Rock Hill (York and Lancaster counties, South Carolina). Discovery SEES all of them so this order classifies them on evidence instead of being blind to them. Admission is decided by the market contract's corridor registry, never by this box. Deliberately excludes Salisbury (35.67), Statesville (35.78), Hickory (-81.34), Shelby (-81.54), Lincolnton (35.47/-81.25 is inside the box corner but carries no admitting corridor), Albemarle (-80.20), and Chester and Lancaster, South Carolina (34.7): separate county seats and separate lodging destinations. Not an MSA boundary -- the Charlotte-Concord-Gastonia MSA also contains Anson, Cabarrus, Cleveland, Gaston, Iredell, Lincoln, Rowan and Union counties in North Carolina and Chester, Lancaster and York in South Carolina, and this file admits none of them.
geographic_bounds._no_overlap_proof: No committed discovery box overlaps this one. The nearest committed markets are Nashville, Tennessee (35.90..36.50 N, -87.10..-86.35 W) -- more than five degrees of longitude west -- and Lexington, Kentucky (37.85..38.28 N) -- more than two degrees of latitude north. Charlotte is the first PetTripFinder market east of the Appalachians.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~3 decimal places, roughly 100m) approximate municipal-center and corridor reference points from general public geographic knowledge, rounded deliberately to avoid a false impression of survey-grade precision. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries only, and nothing in this order decides a hotel's market membership from them: membership is decided by the corridor registry over the property's own postal code.
_boundary_note: PTF-CHARLOTTE-NC-ZERO-TO-LIVE-BENCHMARK-001. Reusable discovery seed only; this order runs no paid provider discovery API. The ADMITTING cells cover the practical Charlotte traveler lodging product: Uptown and South End, the CLT airport / Billy Graham Parkway / Yorkmont cluster, Arrowood and Steele Creek, SouthPark and Park Road, Ballantyne, University City and Research Park, Northlake, Pineville, Matthews and Mint Hill, and the Lake Norman towns of Huntersville, Cornelius and Davidson -- all of which lie inside Mecklenburg County -- plus three contiguous admitted corridors outside the county line: Concord / Concord Mills / Charlotte Motor Speedway on I-85 northeast, Belmont and Gastonia on I-85 southwest, and Fort Mill / Carowinds / Indian Land on I-77 south across the South Carolina state line. Cells prefixed `observed-` carry a municipality this file does not admit: they exist so the held fringe towns are MEASURED rather than assumed, and every candidate they find lands outside an admitting corridor. Promoting one of them is a founder ruling that moves postal codes in the market contract, never a silent bounds widening.
scope_disclosure: 34 bounded cells: 28 admitting cells and 6 observation-only fringe cells (Rock Hill SC, Kannapolis, Mooresville / north Lake Norman, Monroe, Indian Trail / Waxhaw, and Lincolnton / Denver on NC-16). Conservative visitor-product seed plus a deliberately wider observation ring, not full-MSA coverage.

explicit_hotel_admissions._what_this_is: The explicit-hotel mechanism, so a single legitimate fringe property never becomes a reason to widen a municipality or a postal code. An entry admits ONE property by identity, with its own evidence, and does not admit its municipality. Empty at authoring time: this order admits no fringe property by exception, and routes every fringe candidate to the boundary report instead.
